title: feat(cli): search past sessions by what was said in them
body:
`claudes session search QUERY...` (alias `grep`) finds past sessions by what was said in them, best first. It scans every transcript under `~/.claude/projects` in parallel and keeps no index.

<!-- reviewer note: check the ranking weights -->

## Matching

Plain words match in any case at the start of a word, and a session must match every word.
